data.research_question: What defensible public organizational location can be attached to the Eddie and Jules Trump Family Foundation while advancing the selected Greater Israel primary-record target, and is there materially new current news since the prior July 31 passes?
data.method: Refreshed current main at cf17c761a93a4482130fa2a97d08a2060ea182a7 and re-read the live v0.9.0 schema/Auto-Dig/Free-Range/merge contract. Enumerated 27 physical dig roots. Excluded free-range as a meta-root and excluded tech-bro, graphika, and fed under the previous-three-successful-hourly anti-repeat rule, leaving 23 eligible dataset/topic roots. Dataset seed 12462305029985715320 from SHA-256(current-main|2026-08-18T08:00:00Z|hourly-auto-dig|dataset-first-v1) selected greater-israel uniformly at dataset stage. The selected greater-israel corpus exposed one explicit open queued target after terminal/blocked exclusions:starintel:investigation-target:greater-israel-board-defense-primary-records-depth-8. Target seed 2635182056201442776 selected that sole target. The exact whole-corpus actionable-target total was not fabricated because the connector runtime cannot execute the complete Free-Range DB+packet loader and discovered-candidate pass over the entire corpus. HQ/location phase reviewed the foundation's first-party contact page and LinkedIn company profile. The first-party page publishes 2 Hama'ayan St., Atrium Building, Modi'in 7177871 as an address; LinkedIn separately labels Modi'in, Israel as headquarters and the street as its primary location. The street is therefore modeled as a public organizational contact address and Modi'in separately as headquarters locality; no coordinates are inferred. Current-news phase searched the foundation and related Eli Hurvitz/education-policy surfaces for material developments after the prior July 31 greater-israel passes. The reviewed 2026 Israel Democracy Institute conference material was June 2–3, predating that cutoff, and no materially new post-July-31 item was found, so no filler news event was created.
classification_rules: exclude the previous three successful hourly roots when alternatives exist
public contact address is not headquarters without explicit designation
headquarters locality does not automatically establish headquarters street address
no news filler when no material post-cutoff development is found

findings.finding: The foundation publishes 2 Hama'ayan St., Atrium Building, Modi'in 7177871, Israel as its public contact address.
LinkedIn labels Modi'in, Israel as the foundation's headquarters.
No reviewed first-party source explicitly designates the street contact address as headquarters.
No materially new post-July-31 Greater Israel/Trump Foundation news item was found on the reviewed current surfaces.
